coverage.notes: SEL: K-12 competencies adopted by the NJ State Board of Education in August 2017. A 2025 State Board resolution (https://nj.gov/education/sboe/meetings/agenda/2025/March/public/4b_Resolution_Social_and_Emotional_Learning_Week.pdf, dated March 5, 2025) says the Board and Commissioner "continue to recommend" that districts implement them, so this is recommended, not required. Portrait of a Graduate: I found no statewide portrait. The NJDOE page cited here shows a "Future Pathways: a plan for every graduate" priority (career and technical education, dual enrollment) which is not a graduate profile; one local news report mentions a district-level portrait (Ocean City). Not enough to call it none or district-led, so left unknown. Reviewer: search the State Board agendas.

frameworks.name: New Jersey Social and Emotional Learning Competencies and Sub-Competencies
frameworks.issuingBody: New Jersey State Board of Education / New Jersey Department of Education
frameworks.notes: Five competencies, 19 sub-competencies, one grade-neutral list (no grade-band benchmarks). Text was read from NJDOE's accessible PowerPoint copy of the same document (https://www.nj.gov/education/safety/wellness/selearning/docs/SEL-NJCAP.pptx; my tool could not read the PDF itself). Footer: "Adopted by the New Jersey State Board of Education in August 2017". The source has NO item codes: SM/SA/SO/DM/RS codes are FNE labels. The document is a slide, so the grouping of sub-competencies under each competency follows slide order; reviewer: confirm against the PDF layout. Titles are short paraphrases.

items.title: Manage one's emotions, thoughts and behaviors
items.summary: Understand and practice strategies for managing one's own emotions, thoughts and behaviors.

items.title: Recognize skills needed to set and achieve goals
items.summary: Recognize the skills needed to establish and achieve personal and educational goals.

items.title: Persevere and overcome barriers
items.summary: Identify and apply ways to persevere or overcome barriers, using alternative methods, to reach one's goals.

items.title: Recognize one's feelings and thoughts
items.summary: Recognize one's own feelings and thoughts.

items.title: See how feelings and thoughts affect behavior
items.summary: Recognize the impact of one's feelings and thoughts on one's own behavior.

items.title: Recognize personal traits, strengths and limitations
items.summary: Recognize one's personal traits, strengths and limitations.

items.title: Value self-confidence in daily tasks and challenges
items.summary: Recognize the importance of self-confidence in handling daily tasks and challenges.

items.title: Recognize others' thoughts, feelings and perspectives
items.summary: Recognize and identify the thoughts, feelings and perspectives of others.

items.title: Be aware of differences among individuals and groups
items.summary: Show awareness of the differences among individuals, groups and others' cultural backgrounds.

items.title: Show mutual respect when viewpoints differ
items.summary: Show an understanding of the need for mutual respect when viewpoints differ.

items.title: Know the expectations for social interactions in different settings
items.summary: Show awareness of the expectations for social interactions in a variety of settings.

items.title: Problem solving and critical thinking
items.summary: Develop, implement and model effective problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.

items.title: Identify consequences to make constructive choices
items.summary: Identify the consequences of one's actions in order to make constructive choices.

items.title: Evaluate the personal, ethical, safety and civic impact of decisions
items.summary: Evaluate the personal, ethical, safety and civic impact of decisions.

items.title: Use positive communication and social skills
items.summary: Use positive communication and social skills to interact effectively with others.

items.title: Resist inappropriate social pressure
items.summary: Identify ways to resist inappropriate social pressure.

items.title: Prevent and resolve interpersonal conflicts constructively
items.summary: Show the ability to prevent and resolve interpersonal conflicts in constructive ways.

items.title: Know who, when, where and how to seek help
items.summary: Identify who, when, where, or how to seek help for oneself or others when needed.

alignments.framework: New Jersey Social and Emotional Learning Competencies and Sub-Competencies
alignments.rationale: FNE lesson "Stay in Control of Your Spirit" (series: Conflict & Self-Government; the objective is the same in every grade version). FNE's stated objective: "This lesson helps learners recognize what is happening inside them, separate feelings from actions..." Students notice what is happening inside them during conflict or pressure and separate a feeling from the action they take, which is managing one's own emotions and behavior.

target.title: Stay in Control of Your Spirit - Lesson Plan 10 - 23 - #155 - MS

alignments.framework: New Jersey Social and Emotional Learning Competencies and Sub-Competencies
alignments.rationale: Tune Your Brain game "Calm Down Corner" (sel domain; skill: Self-Regulation). FNE's catalog description: "Listen to what happened, then pick what helps you feel calm." Players pick what helps them feel calm, which practises choosing a strategy for managing a feeling. Limit: Short everyday scenarios for younger students; does not cover managing thoughts or behavior in depth.

alignments.framework: New Jersey Social and Emotional Learning Competencies and Sub-Competencies
alignments.rationale: Morning Boost program theme "Emotional Intelligence" (programs.html). FNE's published description: "Understanding and naming emotions, managing reactions, building empathy, and developing the self-awareness that underlies every other social-emotional skill." The theme names managing reactions. Program-level: shows the theme is part of the offering, not which lesson teaches it.

alignments.framework: New Jersey Social and Emotional Learning Competencies and Sub-Competencies
alignments.rationale: FNE lesson "Strengthen the Life You Want to Live" (series: Personal Growth in Action; the objective is the same in every grade version). Limit: Personal direction and routines; it does not teach goal-setting steps or educational planning.
